correctness.rationale: Correct normalization: area is half the full polar squared radial minimum, four periods of length π/2, and beta area 4Γ(1+1/p)^2/Γ(1+2/p). Crossing times are d/2 and (L+d)/2, giving an exact fourfold integral difference. The radial function decreases strictly for fixed 0<p<2; the derivative establishes unique extrema within the reduced domain. Expansion f_p(t)=1-2t^p/p+O(t^{2p}+t²), integration, and interior even Taylor expansion produce the stated coefficients and remainders. The astroid substitution u=(tan t)^(1/3) differentiates to the stated rational integrand. Independent midpoint quadrature diagnostics and symbolic derivative checks, encoded in CHECK.py, passed 163 tests; numerical tests do not prove universal claims.
